final_answer: No, it is not possible to tile an 8x8 chessboard with 2x1 dominoes if two opposite corners are removed. This is because each domino covers one black and one white square, but removing two opposite corners (which are of the same color) leaves an unequal number of black and white squares. Since the dominoes cannot cover an unequal number of squares, tiling becomes impossible.
